SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
GROUP BY team_long_name
HAVING AVG(chanceCreationPassing) < (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes)
ORDER BY chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT Team.team_long_name
FROM Team
JOIN `Match` ON Team.team_api_id = `Match`.away_team_api_id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
AND season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY Team.team_long_name
HAVING MAX(COUNT(*) > 0)

SELECT (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND date = '2013-07-12') - (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND date = '2013-07-12') / (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND date = '2013-07-12') * 100 AS percentage

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
AND buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL)

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN `Match` ON League.id = `Match`.league_id
WHERE `Match`.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY League.name
HAVING AVG(`Match`.home_team_goal) > AVG(`Match`.away_team_goal);

SELECT home_team_goal, away_team_goal
FROM `Match`
WHERE date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
AND League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT player_name, player_api_id, player_fifa_api_id, birthday, height, weight, overall_rating, potential, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate, defensive_work_rate, crossing, finishing, heading_accuracy, short_passing, volleys, dribbling, curve, free_kick_accuracy, long_passing, ball_control, acceleration, sprint_speed, agility, reactions, balance, shot_power, jumping, stamina, strength, long_shots, aggression, interceptions, positioning, vision, penalties, marking, standing_tackle, sliding_tackle, gk_diving, gk_handling, gk_kicking, gk_positioning, gk_reflexes, age
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE sprint_speed >= 97 AND YEAR(date) >= '2013' AND YEAR(date) <= '2015'
SELECT (overall_rating WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') - (overall_rating WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel') AS difference;

SELECT AVG(overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' 
AND date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(AVG(finishing)) AS highest_average_finishing_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
OR player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT AVG(t2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes t2
JOIN Player t1 ON t2.player_api_id = t1.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015' AND t1.height > 170;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
AND preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY player_api_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
JOIN League ON `Match`.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' 
AND strftime('%Y-%m', `Match`.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT player_name, AVG(heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
GROUP BY player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT MAX(chanceCreationPassing) AS highest_chance_creation_passing, chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE team_long_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE finishing = 1
ORDER BY birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS "Highest Build Up Play Speed", team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE team_long_name IN (
    SELECT team_long_name
    FROM Team_Attributes
    JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
    GROUP BY team_long_name
    ORDER BY MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
GROUP BY team_long_name
ORDER BY MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) DESC;

SELECT buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag';

SELECT AVG(home_team_goal) 
FROM Match 
WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Poland') 
AND season = '2010/2011';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE balance = (
        SELECT MAX(balance)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE potential = 61
    )
    AND potential = 61
);

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team
JOIN `Match` ON Team.team_api_id = `Match`.away_team_api_id
WHERE away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM `Match`);

SELECT team_short_name
FROM Team
WHERE team_api_id IN (
    SELECT home_team_api_id
    FROM `Match`
    WHERE home_team_goal = 10
);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010'
AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date,1,4) = '2010');

SELECT date
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
ORDER BY crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Belgium Jupiler League') 
AND SUBSTR(`date`, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT finishing, curve
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT home_team_api_id
FROM `Match`
WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND SUBTRACT(home_team_goal, away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY home_team_api_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS matches_played
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY matches_played DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player_Attributes.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT (COUNT(height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70) / COUNT(id)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT AVG(away_team_goal) 
FROM `Match` 
JOIN Team ON `Match`.away_team_api_id = Team.team_api_id 
JOIN Country ON `Match`.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND Country.name = 'Italy';

SELECT potential
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini' AND Player_Attributes.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN `Match` ON League.id = `Match`.league_id
WHERE `Match`.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(`Match`.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT Team_Attributes.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND Team_Attributes.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player
ORDER BY birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal)
FROM `Match` m
JOIN Player_Attributes pa1 ON m.away_player_1 = pa1.player_api_id AND pa1.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON m.away_player_2 = pa2.player_api_id AND pa2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira'

SELECT l.name, SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference;

SELECT chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND Player_Attributes.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_api_id IN (
      SELECT player_api_id
      FROM Player
      WHERE player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
    )
  )
);

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND Team_Attributes.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT p.birthday
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND Team_Attributes.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
WHERE season = '2015/2016' 
AND league_id IN (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League');

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
ORDER BY player_api_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT MAX(home_team_goal) AS highest_score
FROM `Match`
WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Netherlands')
AND league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie');

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player.player_name, Country.name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
JOIN Country ON Player.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Player_Attributes.vision >= 90;

SELECT Player_Attributes.long_passing
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
ORDER BY Player.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2011'
AND player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas');

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada')
ORDER BY birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT Country.name
FROM Country
JOIN Player ON Country.id = Player.country_id
GROUP BY Country.name
ORDER BY AVG(Player.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
JOIN Player_Attributes ON `Match`.home_player_1 = Player_Attributes.player_api_id 
WHERE Player_Attributes.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM `Match` 
WHERE season = '2008/2009' 
AND country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Belgium');

SELECT player_name, MAX(height) AS tallest_height
FROM Player;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Germany';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT Player_Attributes.potential
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Aaron Doran';

SELECT Country.name
FROM Country
JOIN League ON Country.id = League.country_id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT s.id
FROM sets s
WHERE s.type = 'commander'
ORDER BY s.totalSetSize DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.status
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.frameVersion = '1997'
AND c.artist = 'D. Alexander Gregory'
AND c.hasContentWarning = 1
AND l.format = 'legacy';

SELECT 
  (SUM(isOnlineOnly = 1) / SUM(language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)')) * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
  cards
WHERE 
  language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)';

SELECT c.uuid, r.text, c.hasContentWarning
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Jim Pavelec';

SELECT 
    SUM(isNonFoilOnly = 1) / SUM(language = 'Japanese') * 100 AS percentage
FROM 
    cards
WHERE 
    language = 'Japanese';

SELECT s.id
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.isForeignOnly = 0
AND s.isFoilOnly = 1
AND st.language = 'Japanese';

SELECT c.id, r.text, c.hasContentWarning
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniel';

SELECT cards.name, legalities.format
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.name IN (
    SELECT foreign_data.name
    FROM foreign_data
    JOIN sets ON foreign_data.uuid = sets.uuid
    WHERE sets.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
)
AND legalities.status = 'Legal';

SELECT l.status
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact' AND c.side IS NULL AND l.format = 'vintage';

SELECT format, GROUP_CONCAT(name) AS card_names
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE status = 'Banned'
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL
AND l.format = 'commander'
AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
WHERE sets.name = 'Coldsnap' AND cards.convertedManaCost > 5 AND (cards.power = '*' OR cards.power IS NULL);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE rarity = 'rare' 
AND types = 'Enchantment' 
AND name = 'Abundance' 
AND status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sets
WHERE code IN (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'Italian'
)
AND baseSetSize < 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards) AS percentage
FROM cards
JOIN set_translations ON cards.uuid = set_translations.uuid
WHERE set_translations.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND cards.isOnlineOnly = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.name NOT LIKE '%Japanese%'
AND st.language = 'Korean';

SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion, artist, uuid
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Allen Williams'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion, artist, uuid
FROM cards
WHERE status = 'Banned';

SELECT r.text
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Kev Walker'
ORDER BY r.date DESC;

SELECT f.name
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
AND f.language = 'Italian'
AND c.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards WHERE setCode = 'Coldsnap');

SELECT c.name, c.convertedManaCost
FROM cards c
WHERE c.name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')
ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT language
FROM foreign_data
WHERE uuid IN (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Angel of Mercy'
);

SELECT c.artist, s.format
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY c.artist, s.format
HAVING COUNT(c.id) = (
    SELECT MIN(COUNT(c.id))
    FROM cards c
    JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode
    JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY c.artist
);

SELECT c.manaCost
FROM cards c
WHERE c.layout = 'normal'
  AND c.frameVersion = '2003'
  AND c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND c.availability = 'mtgo,paper';

SELECT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*'
AND l.promoTypes = 'arenaleague'
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT AVG(COUNT(*)) AS annual_average_sets, MAX(language) AS common_language
FROM sets
WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY YEAR(releaseDate);

SELECT MIN(originalReleaseDate) AS oldest_release_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT format) AS legal_formats
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE rarity = 'mythic';

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
  HAVING COUNT(uuid) = (
    SELECT MAX(count_uuid)
    FROM (
      SELECT COUNT(uuid) AS count_uuid
      FROM rulings
      GROUP BY uuid
    )
  )
) r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
ORDER BY c.isPromo DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frameEffects
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY frameEffects
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE format = 'premodern' 
AND text LIKE '%This is a triggered mana ability.%' 
AND side IS NULL;

SELECT c.uuid, c.name, f.language
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE c.originalType = 'Artifact' AND c.colors = 'B';

SELECT artist
FROM cards
WHERE side IS NULL
ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1 AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT f.name
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE c.type = 'Creature'
  AND c.layout = 'normal'
  AND c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND f.language = 'French'
  AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sets
WHERE block = 'Ice Age' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE sets.code = set_translations.setCode AND language = 'Italian' AND translation IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*' 
AND hasFoil = 0 
AND duelDeck = 'a';

SELECT s.name, st.translation
FROM sets s
LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.mtgoCode IS NULL OR s.mtgoCode = ''
ORDER BY st.translation ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.translation
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE st.language = 'Italian'
AND s.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
JOIN foreign_data ON cards.uuid = foreign_data.uuid 
WHERE cards.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND foreign_data.language = 'Korean';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*' 
AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%';

SELECT c.uuid
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic' AND l.status = 'Banned' AND l.format = 'gladiator';

SELECT c1.id AS foil_id, c2.id AS card_id
FROM cards c1
JOIN cards c2 ON c1.cardKingdomFoilId = c2.cardKingdomId
WHERE c1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c2.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c1.cardKingdomFoilId ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM set_translations 
WHERE language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)' AND setCode IN (
    SELECT code 
    FROM sets 
    WHERE block = 'Commander'
);

SELECT f.language
FROM foreign_data f
JOIN cards c ON f.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND s.code = 'ARC';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sets.code)
FROM sets
JOIN foreign_data ON sets.uuid = foreign_data.uuid
WHERE foreign_data.language = 'Japanese' AND sets.mtgoCode IS NULL;

SELECT st.translation
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE st.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND s.name = 'Mirrodin';

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE st.translation = 'Tendo Ice Bridge';

SELECT s.name, s.totalSetSize
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE st.language = 'Italian';

SELECT f.flavorText
FROM foreign_data f

SELECT Segment, 
       MAX(Percentage_Increase) AS Max_Percentage_Increase,
       MIN(Percentage_Increase) AS Min_Percentage_Increase
FROM (
  SELECT Segment,
         (Consumption_2013 - Consumption_2012) / Consumption_2013 * 100 AS Percentage_Increase
  FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym2013.Consumption AS Consumption_2013,
           ym2012.Consumption AS Consumption_2012
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym2013 ON c.CustomerID = ym2013.CustomerID AND ym2013.Date LIKE '2013%'
    JOIN yearmonth ym2012 ON c.CustomerID = ym2012.CustomerID AND ym2012.Date LIKE '2012%'
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  )
)
GROUP BY Segment;
